''See also: [[Sage of the Silver Heart Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Akura Charity]], known as the [[Sage]] of the [[Silver Heart]], is a powerful figure who serves as the mistress of her castle and acts as the authoritative voice for both the Akura clan{{!}}Akura family and humanity. As an [[Archlady]] at the peak of the [[Lord realm]], she possesses a unique status that distinguishes her from other Archlord{{!}}Archlords. Her abilities are tied to the [[Book of the Silver Heart]], which contains seven specific techniques involving [[dreams]] and Shadow{{!}}shadow. She is capable of manifesting a silver and purple icon that appears as a massive book featuring a central eye. [[Charity]] is characterized by her intense emotional control and cold logic, though she has occasionally shown signs of internal struggle or nervousness. Her influence is vast; she can command emperors and possesses the power to manipulate minds or provide intuitive guidance to others. She is also a skilled craftswoman, having created both swords and a Goldsteel{{!}}goldsteel statue.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Akura Charity]] is a woman who possesses deep purple eyes. She maintains the appearance of someone under twenty years of age.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|As a member of the Akura clan{{!}}Akura family, she holds specific views on clan loyalty and would be unhappy if Seishen Daji{{!}}Daji killed one of her kin. She has taken a hostile interest in Prince Seishen Kiro{{!}}Kiro and maintains a policy of restricted bloodshed.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|She has the power to fade into Shadow{{!}}shadow and can weave space and Shadow{{!}}shadow together to form portals. Additionally, she utilizes a [[technique]] capable of inducing unnatural terror.}}
